item.title: Amazon deepens OpenAI ties with US$50B AWS expansion
item.summary: Amazon has completed the latest round of its US$50 billion investment in OpenAI, fully funding an originally conditional financing package that gives it about a 5% stake in the company and further deepens the two sides' long-term cooperation in cloud, AI chips, and infrastructure. For Amazon, this is not just an equity investment, but a strategic move to trade capital for AI compute demand and cloud growth.
